<thought>Using the monoisotopic masses of C (12.0000), H (1.007825), and O (15.994915), the formula C6H14O3 gives a calculated exact mass of 134.0943 Da, which is the closest match to the observed molecular ion at m/z 134.1096. Therefore the most plausible molecular formula is C6H14O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H14O3</final_answer>
